title: Graphic Designer
description:
Job Posting
Sick of commuting? Tired of “hybrid” jobs that are really “in office” jobs in disguise? If you’re more productive at home than in an office, and want to make that arrangement permanent, we may have the position you’re after.
At CarriersEdge , we’re focused on producing great quality products and happy customers. We don’t care about being the coolest company in town, having the most amazing office perks, or the hippest staff. If you’re interested in those things, you’ll hate us.
On the other hand, if you’re not looking for a social group and just want to do great work, then you may be exactly what we’re looking for. We don’t care where you work and we won’t be looking over your shoulder micromanaging you. You’ll have minimal meetings disrupting your week, and plenty of time to focus on doing the best job possible. We’re growing, but not so quickly that things are chaotic.
As part of that growth, we’ve got an opening for a Graphic Designer.
The ideal candidate has a solid foundation in the skills outlined below, is a self-learner with a great work ethic, and has a keen interest in communicating through visual design.
This isn’t a big company with layers of bureaucracy and committees for every decision. It’s also not an agency where you’ll get crushed by client demands and deadlines. Our business is established and stable, but still small enough that we can move quickly. If you fit the profile below, send us your résumé and a link to your portfolio and let’s talk.
About You

• You like to understand the “why” behind any assignment, including the context of the end user, so that your design solutions will be effective for the intended audience

• You’re a creative generalist, comfortable delivering across media - from print and web to social and video - and you like to teach yourself new tools

• You have advanced knowledge of After Effects best practices. You’re the person everyone goes to for tips and the go-to resource for major projects

• You're equally comfortable collaborating with others or working solo, and you can reliably build on the design work of others.

• You are meticulously organized, in ways that other designers can easily follow. Badly-organized files make you physically ill.

• You thrive on feedback, recognizing that continuous improvement comes from practice and outside input.

Your Typical Week
Reporting to the Creative Manager, you will collaborate with team members from Marketing and Content Services to design marketing materials and interactive courses.
Day to day, you will work with the team to create visuals in support of multiple brands, campaigns, and projects. This will include websites, social media, advertising, and instructional content.
With 12-15 projects underway at any given time, a normal week will see you balancing time between short term tasks (social media, webinars) and larger projects (course development, website redesigns), while also keeping ongoing activities on track.
As part of a remote team, you will connect with team members across the company through Slack, email, and Zoom.
Requirements

• Post-secondary education in Graphic Design or a related field

• 5+ years of progressively senior experience, preferably in B2B, SaaS, or agency environments.

• A portfolio that demonstrates experience with both digital and print assignments

• Demonstrable, expert knowledge of After Effects or similar motion graphics tools

• Strong knowledge of other Adobe Creative Suite applications (e.g. Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro)

• Excellent attention to detail and ability read thoroughly and follow instructions, so please find a way to mention Alaska in your cover letter

• Ability to work independently, but also closely with other designers, developers, and marketing teams to ensure visual designs align with project goals

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal

• MUST reside in Canada

title: Head of Private Equity and Advisory Partnerships
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups-use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Private Equity and Advisory Partnerships (PEP) team manages Stripe’s relationships with growth equity, private equity, and advisory firms. The team works with investors and advisors to help portfolio companies use Stripe to grow revenue and improve profitability.

What you’ll do

You will lead a team of Partnerships Managers and shape the strategy for expanding Stripe product use across private equity-backed companies. You will build relationships with investors, advisors, and portfolio company leaders, then work with Stripe’s sales, product, marketing, and operations teams to identify and develop long-term business opportunities. 

Responsibilities

• Lead and develop a team of Partnerships Managers with experience in sales and private equity

• Set the team’s long-term vision and strategy, manage day-to-day operations, and deliver against key metrics

• Build and maintain partner-level relationships with private equity firms and their portfolio companies through strategic planning and collaboration

• Partner with Americas and global go-to-market leadership to communicate the team’s strategy, results, performance metrics, and industry insights

• Work cross-functionally across sales, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, and product management to deliver the program’s goals

• Represent Stripe in the financial sponsor ecosystem, including through relevant industry events and speaking opportunities

• Advise private equity firms on prospective investment opportunities and payments monetization across their portfolios, and educate financial sponsors on Stripe’s products, roadmap, and vision for financial technology and money movement

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 15+ years of experience in business development, sales, private equity, investment banking, or management consulting, including 5+ years of people management experience

• 7+ years of experience working with senior executives

• 5+ years of experience using data and metrics to drive commercial outcomes for a business and its customers or partners

Preferred requirements

• Experience at a technology or payments company

• Experience creating and implementing a strategic plan for a growing team

• Strong relationship-building skills and attention to detail, with the ability to cultivate partnerships and oversee programs at scale

• Ability to manage cross-functional projects and multiple priorities, with strong organizational skills

• Knowledge of investment terminology and relevant industry performance metrics

• Financial modeling experience

• Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills

• Comfort working in a fast-paced environment

title: Senior Product Manager, Fulfillment
description:
About Faire

Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town - we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

About this role

Fulfillment is one of Faire's top long-term strategic bets that fundamentally changes how both brands and retailers do business. You'll play an instrumental role in scaling Faire's fulfillment business from 1% to 20%+ of GMV, working across the full problem space of brand supply, retailer demand, and unit economics to build the products and operational foundations that make Faire the best way for brands to fulfill wholesale and the most flexible, valuable way for retailers to stock their stores.

The product problems you'll tackle are both digital and physical in nature, spanning marketplace dynamics, operational systems, and program economics. You'll partner cross-functionally and with senior fulfillment leads to drive end-to-end execution and strategy on key workstreams touching brands, retailers, and operations.

We're looking for a product manager with deep empathy for how our customers' businesses actually work, relentless execution in ambiguous 0→1 environments, and the instinct to always connect what they're building to why it matters for the broader business.

What you’ll do 

• Brand supply.  Build onboarding, sales enablement, and operational tooling that makes it easier and more compelling for brands to fulfill through Faire, with a deep understanding of what it actually takes for a brand to change how they operate.

• Retailer demand.  Drive 50%+ growth to participating brands through Faire Source by closing the discovery, conversion, and cart experience gaps that hold retailers back from making it their primary way to buy.

• Fulfillment experience.  Build toward 90%+ of Faire-fulfilled orders being perfectly delivered, while identifying the net new levers that make fulfillment a genuine differentiator on both sides of the marketplace.

• Unit economics.  Partner with S&A and operations to generate leverage and halve the cost of fulfillment as we scale, from order batching and 3PL collaboration to brand consolidation.

• Cross-functional execution.  Work in close partnership with engineering, design, operations, GTM, finance, and data science to ship end-to-end - defining success metrics and communicating progress, tradeoffs, and decisions clearly across the org.

Qualifications

• Business empathy . You understand how your customers' businesses actually work, not just their user flows. Fulfillment asks brands and retailers to make fundamental operational changes; you grasp those stakes and can navigate the marketplace tradeoffs when their interests intersect.

• Cross-functional execution . You relentlessly chase down problems across eng, ops, design, analytics, and GTM. You earn trust quickly, lead without authority, and work in lockstep with a fast-moving team.

• Systems thinking . You understand how your work fits into the broader puzzle. You don't build shopping experiences without thinking about unit economics, or build brand tooling without thinking about ops partnership.

• Structured problem solving . You systematically break down hard problems and bring creativity and resourcefulness to finding durable solutions.

• Analytical depth . You're fluent

title: Freight Agent (Independent Contractor)
description:
About Primary Freight
Primary Freight is a freight brokerage with eight agent branches across the United States. As part of Primary Companies , we work alongside our asset based trucking operations, pallet manufacturing, and sawmill divisions to offer customers complete logistics solutions.
About the Role
We are looking for experienced Freight Agents to join our network as independent contractors. This is a 1099 contract position, not a W2 employee role, and compensation is 100% commission with no base pay. We state this upfront because this structure works best for agents who already have freight experience and an existing or transferable book of business.
As a Freight Agent, you bring your customer relationships and book the freight. Primary Freight provides the back office, technology, insurance, and carrier network so you can focus on moving loads and growing your accounts.
Day to Day Responsibilities

• Prospect and contact potential shipping customers to build client relationships

• Quote, book, and manage shipments from pickup through delivery

• Negotiate rates with carriers and customers

• Track loads and communicate proactively with shippers and carriers

• Complete shipment documentation and resolve transit issues as they arise

What Primary Freight Provides

• Cargo and liability insurance coverage

• DAT load posting access and Truckstop login

• Carrier onboarding and tracking software with access to 40,000+ vetted carriers

• Company email, TMS access, and LTL portal access

• EDI and customer portal capability

• Customer invoicing, collections, and back office support

• Orientation, training, and support transitioning existing customers

• Fast carrier setup for new contracts

Qualifications

• 2+ years of experience in freight brokerage, logistics, or transportation (required)

• An existing or transferable book of business, or demonstrated ability to build one

• Working knowledge of freight brokerage operations and carrier negotiation

• Strong communication, negotiation, and problem solving skills

• Background in customer service and account management

How Pay Works
This role operates on a revenue share model. You keep a percentage of the gross margin on every delivered load. Primary Freight's share covers the services we provide on your behalf, including insurance, TMS and load board software, carrier vetting and onboarding, customer invoicing, collections, and back office support. There are no fees, no startup costs, and nothing to purchase. You are never charged for the tools or support.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR) - SEO & B2B SaaS
description:
About the Opportunity
LMG Staffing Solutions is conducting a confidential search on behalf of a fast-growing, fully remote marketing agency that helps funded B2B SaaS and technology companies win visibility in traditional and AI-powered search. The company has nearly doubled revenue over the past year and is building its first-ever sales development function to keep pace with a growing stream of inbound demand. This is a newly created role reporting directly to the Founder, sitting outside the delivery-focused teams (content, strategy, and link building).
Position Summary
The Sales Development Representative (SDR) will be the first point of contact for a steady stream of inbound, outbound (ABM), and reactivation leads, and will play a key role in building the company’s outbound systems from the ground up. This is not a generic dialer role - the ideal candidate has real experience selling into B2B SaaS or funded tech startups, can hold a credible first conversation with senior marketing and growth buyers, and is motivated to grow into a more senior sales role as the function scales. The role starts part-time (~20 hours/week), with a 90-day review for a move to full-time based on performance and lead volume.
Requirements
Key Responsibilities
Lead Response & Qualification

• Respond same-day, ideally within the hour, to every inbound, outbound (ABM), and reactivation handoff - across email, LinkedIn, and phone/text

• Qualify every lead against ICP criteria, protecting the founder’s calendar from below-budget or bad-fit prospects

• Book qualified discovery calls - turning a reply into a booked next step is the core measure of the role

Multi-Channel Outbound & Prospecting

• Run second-channel follow-up (call, text, LinkedIn) wherever email goes quiet on handoffs from inbound and ABM

• Self-source prospecting against the company’s ICP during downtime between handoffs - LinkedIn outreach and targeted email to build pipeline beyond inbound and ABM

• Support the development and execution of high-value, niche outbound campaigns (e.g., targeted email and direct mail to a curated list of key accounts) in partnership with the founder

CRM & Sales Systems

• Keep the CRM clean and current - every touch, stage move, and next action logged as you go

• Help select, configure, and maintain outreach tooling as the company builds out its sales stack; the team is open to your recommendations on platforms

Coaching & Growth

• Shadow the founder’s calls and playbook early on, then operate independently as you prove it out

• Build toward a more senior sales role as the function and lead volume scale

Qualifications

• B2B SaaS or sales-development experience, ideally selling to funded tech startups - prioritized over specific SEO or digital-marketing expertise

• Able to hold a credible first conversation with marketing, growth, or founder-level buyers

• Exposure to the SEO/AEO or digital-marketing space is a plus, but not required

• Organized and responsive across multiple channels - phone, LinkedIn, email, and CRM

• Coachable and fast-learning, comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy in a lean, remote-first environment

• Based in the United States; Eastern or Central time zone preferred to support overlap with a globally distributed team and West Coast clients (soft preference)

Preferred Skills

• Multi-Channel Outbound Prospecting

• Lead Qualification (ICP-Based)

• B2B SaaS / Tech Startup Sales Experience

• CRM Management & Pipeline Hygiene

• Sales Outreach Tool Selection & Setup (e.g., Apollo or similar)

• Relationship Building & Written Communication

• Cold Email & Direct Mail Campaign Development

What Success Looks Like

• Response speed (non-negotiable): same-day, within-the-hour response on every handoff, no exceptions

• Booked calls: 15-20 qualified discovery calls booked per month, roughly one per day, across handoff response and self-sourced outreach

• The founder stops being the bottleneck on responding

title: Director, CAR T Channel Strategy & Operations
description:
Kyverna Therapeutics is a patient-centered, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing cell therapies for patients suffering from autoimmune diseases. Guided by our core values, Stay True to Why, Collaborate to Accelerate, Lead with Clarity, Boldly Innovative, and Own the Outcome , we are committed to transforming the future of treatment for autoimmune disease. Join us at the forefront of cell therapy innovation and help redefine what’s possible.

Position Overview

Kyverna is seeking Associate Dir./Director, CAR T Channel Distribution. The role is responsible for the development, execution, and continuous improvement of the commercial channel infrastructure supporting CAR T therapy delivery. This role provides leadership for distribution, third-party logistics (3PL), specialty pharmacy strategy, state licensing, government pricing support, and channel governance activities. The position partners closely with Market Access, Commercial, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and Supply Chain teams to ensure scalable, compliant, and customer-focused channel operations that support current and future CAR T commercialization efforts.

Department: Commercial
Location: Remote eligible
Reports To: VP, Global Market Access

Responsibilities

• Develop and execute channel operations that balance customer experience, operational efficiency, compliance requirements, and gross-to-net (GTN) optimization.

• Serve as business owner for third-party logistics (3PL) partnerships and distribution operations supporting CAR T commercialization.

• Partner on specialty pharmacy and distribution development to support current and future portfolio needs.

• Partner with Market Access, Finance, Commercial, and Legal teams to analyze channel design alternatives and their impact on GTN performance.

• Assess channel economics and develop recommendations that optimize reimbursement, contracting, distribution costs, and commercial profitability while maintaining customer satisfaction.

• Oversee state licensing strategy, renewals, compliance requirements, and regulatory readiness.

• Support government pricing activities through cross-functional coordination, process governance, and operational oversight.

• Lead distribution governance, QBR's, service-level management, and operational performance reviews across external partners.

• Support launch planning, market expansion, and new product introductions through scalable channel infrastructure.

• Develop reporting, analytics, and performance metrics that provide visibility into channel effectiveness and operational health.

• Identify and mitigate operational, regulatory, and commercial risks across the distribution network.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.

• 10+ years of experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical, specialty distribution, market access, commercial operations, or related functions.

• Experience developing and executing channel strategies for specialty pharmaceuticals, cell therapies, gene therapies, or other complex therapies.

• Strong understanding of gross-to-net (GTN) principles, channel economics, distribution agreements, and commercial contracting.

• Demonstrated ability to design channel solutions that optimize GTN performance while meeting customer, provider, and patient requirements.

The national salary range for this position is from $190,000 to $230,000 USD annually. This salary range is an estimate of what we reasonably expect to pay for this posted position, and the actual salary may vary based on various factors, including without limitation individual education, experience, tenure, skills and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and customer success planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re a builder who loves helping customers solve real business problems-and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact-this is the role.

 

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

 

WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

- Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts, ensuring customers expand their use of Notion and as a result, Notion sees high NRR

- Partner closely with the Solutions Consultant on account strategy for expansion and renewal, including owning the renewal opportunity for flat and at-risk customers

- Shape customer outcomes, strengthen executive and team-level partnerships, and contribute directly to predictable revenue through retention, renewal, and expansion impact

- Design and deploy workflows that solve specific business problems as a build-beside partner to the customer, translating goals into durable systems in Notion

- Partner with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, customer planning, and identifying and qualifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts

title: Account Executive, Product Sales - Crypto
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups-use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe’s Crypto Product Sales team is helping businesses move value into, out of, and across crypto ecosystems. We work with fintechs, platforms, marketplaces, and crypto-native companies to accept stablecoin payments, send funds globally, and make it easier for users to move between fiat and crypto. Our current focus spans stablecoin payins and payouts, Crypto Onramp, and other digital asset funding flows.

If turning crypto into practical global financial infrastructure excites you… you’ll fit right in.

What you’ll do

As an Account Executive on the Crypto Product Sales team, you’ll grow adoption and revenue for Stripe’s crypto products and the financial infrastructure that powers them. You’ll collaborate with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and other GTM teams to develop deep product and industry knowledge, lead complex deals, and help build and execute our go-to-market strategy.

This is a high-autonomy sales role on a close-knit team. You can move comfortably between business, product, and technical conversations, build value in competitive situations, and bring structure to an evolving market. You’re equally effective with customers and internal partners, excited to develop deep expertise, and generous about sharing what you learn.

Responsibilities

• Own a revenue target and the end-to-end commercial motion for Stripe’s crypto products, from pipeline development and qualification through negotiation, close, and launch.

• Qualify customer business models, fund flows, target geographies, end-user journeys, and regulatory readiness.

• Develop a deep understanding of the competitive and partner landscape, and use it to sharpen Stripe’s positioning.

• Lead technically and commercially complex sales involving stablecoin acceptance, fiat-to-crypto conversion, digital asset funding flows, global payouts, platform money movement, and cross-border economics.

• Navigate stakeholders across internal Risk, Compliance, and Legal teams, as well as financial and technology partners, from early qualification through launch.

• Use early customer engagements to develop repeatable segmentation, qualification criteria, commercial models, and GTM playbooks.

• Bring structured market feedback to Product and Engineering as the product and market rapidly evolve.

• Bring curiosity, good judgment, and a sense of humor - we’re building the playbook as we go.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Requirements

• 5+ years of customer-facing experience in technology, fintech, crypto, payments, or financial infrastructure, with a track record of strong performance.

• Experience building trusted advisor relationships with senior business leaders.

• Proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with cross-functional business partners.

• Self-starter capable of operating independently to drive meaningful business results.

• Willingness to roll up your sleeves and build where there isn’t yet a playbook.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Ability to understand complex technical requirements and craft solutions that address the needs of multiple stakeholders.

• Proven experience leading complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements.

• Thrives in a fast-paced environmen

ITC Federal , LLC (ITC) connects technology advancements in automation and AI, customer experience, and financial services to solve government mission challenges, enabling smoother operational efficiency and bolstering national security. We leverage the latest technology innovations and proven approaches to better serve the mission and support the DHS, DOJ, and DoW workforce, customers, and programs, regardless of scale or complexity. ITC is located in Fairfax, VA and offers an outstanding compensation and benefits plan and a challenging and rewarding professional work environment.
We are seeking an experienced E-Discovery Technical and Legal Support to support ITC Federal ’s work for the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) under the anticipated MEGA 6 automated litigation support (ALS) program. This is a fully remote position supporting DOJ’s complex litigation mission.
Important: This opening is being established in connection with the MEGA 6 contract vehicle award itself. The E-Discovery Technical and Legal Support resource provides combined technical and legal eDiscovery support to the DOJ Justice Management Division (JMD) e-discovery program. MEGA 6 is expected to continue DOJ’s multiple-award contract vehicle for automated litigation support (ALS) services, following the structure of the MEGA 5 contract. These contracts are designed to provide DOJ offices, boards, divisions, and other federal agencies with information technology, professional services, and litigation support tools to manage complex legal proceedings efficiently.

• Stay current on emerging eDiscovery technology, processes, and legal developments.

REQUIRED:

• Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Public Trust clearance prior to start (candidates are not required to be cleared at the time of application).

• Authorized to work in the United States.

• Ability to work effectively in a fully remote environment.

• Experience providing eDiscovery technical and/or legal support on complex matters.

• Thorough understanding of the Electronic Discovery Reference Model (EDRM), including collection, processing, review, analytics, and production.

Tracing its roots back to 1933, MDD is one of the world’s top forensic accounting firms specializing in economic damage quantification calculations. With forensic accounting professionals in over 40 offices on 5 continents, MDD has global resources to assist our clients with their forensic accounting needs. MDD helps insurance companies, independent adjustment firms, multinational corporations, government entities, and individuals calculate the true economic damage of claims or disputes. MDD is looking for a Manager to serve as an essential function of the forensic accounting team. The ideal candidate will have a sound technical background in accounting/finance, possess strong communication and analytical skills, and can work independently. They will work with clients and senior management to build claim-level allocation models, create decision-making tools and analytics, and accurately report on results and progress to senior management, clients, and related stakeholders throughout the large, complex claims exposure evaluation process.

Key Responsibilities

• Preliminary to intermediate analysis of sales, production and other accounting data

• Physical inventory observation, price testing

• Examination of source documents pertinent to engagement

• Perform insightful quantitative analysis on potential policy exposure for long-tail or complex commercial casualty insurance claims

• Build and model loss allocation scenarios for mass torts, including Asbestos, Hazardous Waste, Sexual Abuse & Molestation, PFAS, Concussive Injuries, Pharmaceuticals, Toxic Torts, etc...

• Create customized solutions dependent on customer needs, combining insurance, data, and jurisdictionally driven legal opinions to accurately model pertinent scenarios

• Collect and organize data from various sources, ensuring data accuracy and completeness.

• Check and proof reports and schedules

• Research, data analysis and evaluation

• Ensure compliance with state and federal laws

• Research and other tasks assigned by manager

Skills, knowledge & expertise

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in Mathematics, Finance, Economics, or related field required.

• At least three years of experience in allocating long-tail insurance claims as a consultant or in-house required.

• Excellent Excel, Word, Data Analysis, and other relevant software skills required.

• Strong written, oral communication and presentation skills.

• Proven capability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a fast-paced, team environment.

• Excellent organizational skills with ability to handle multiple complex projects at various stages of completeness at any given time.

Time Doctor is hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own the marketing-led customer journey from the moment an account starts paying. Who we are
Time Doctor is a workforce analytics platform that gives distributed teams the visibility they need to improve trust and performance. We serve remote, hybrid and outsourced organisations worldwide, with particular strength in BPO, healthcare and tech services. We are bootstrapped, profitable and fully remote, with team members across 30+ countries. Who you are

• You are commercially minded. You turn customer signals into revenue.

• You are analytical and cohort-fluent. You read behaviour and act on where customers stall or grow.

• You think in systems. You would rather build a repeatable, automated flow than run another one-off campaign.

Data at Confido feeds customer-facing reports, internal dashboards, and a lot of day-to-day decisions. Right now it lives in too many places and is owned by too many people. We're hiring a Data Engineering Manager to fix that and to build the team that keeps it fixed.

title: Senior Security Engineer, Research & Engineering (United Kingdom)
description:
Location: Remote within the United Kingdom
Who We Are:
Founded in 2012 by 3 expert hackers with no investment capital, Trail of Bits is the premier place for security experts to boldly advance security and address technology's newest and most challenging risks. It has helped secure some of the world's most targeted organizations and devices. Our combination of novel research with practical solutions reduces the security risks that our clients face from emerging technologies. Our work helps drive the security industry and the public's understanding of the technology that underlies our world.
Cybersecurity preparedness is a moving target. Companies like ours are the tip of the spear in the fight against attackers. Our research-based and custom-engineering approach ensures that our clients' capabilities are at the forefront of what's available. For companies and technologies that live and die by their security, a proactive, tailored approach is required to keep one step ahead of attackers.
Democratizing security information is essential. As part of our business, we provide ongoing informational support through blogs, whitepapers, newsletters, meetups, and open-source tools. The more the community understands security, the more they'll understand why a company like ours is so unique and valuable.
Role
AI has transformed the cost curve for formal verification. Network boundaries, infrastructure, operating system components, cryptographic libraries, and proof-checking kernels can now ship with genuine mathematical guarantees attached, and those guarantees are narrower than the word "verified" leads anyone to believe. We are looking for candidates who have both the rigor to read a proof and say exactly what it establishes, and the instinct to find what it left out.
Day-to-day, you will evaluate specifications alongside their designs and proofs, and determine what has actually been established versus what has merely been assumed. Then, using state-of-the-art tools and frontier AI models, you will go after everything the proof does not reach. Some of what you find may be ordinary memory corruption. More of it will be a threat model that ignores a real attacker, a trusted computing base that does not survive deployment, or a sound proof of a property adjacent to the one that matters.
Red-team evaluations are scheduled for a one-week sprint with seven weeks to prepare. The tooling you build during that time determines how much ground you cover once the window opens. Trail of Bits is AI-native, and we expect AI to drive the bulk of our evaluations with agentic harnesses, triage pipelines, automated exploit generation, and systems like Buttercup, our cyber reasoning system that placed second at DARPA's AI Cyber Challenge.
You will work in small teams and with third parties and report to a domain lead in applied cryptography and proof systems, operating system internals, applications, hardware, or AI infrastructure. Several engagements will run simultaneously and remain separate, so holding information where it belongs matters as much as the technical work. Occasionally, you will attend sprints and hackathon events in London.
What You'll Achieve

• Break systems built to resist you. Compromise designs and production software whose authors had a proof assistant on their side, and demonstrate it with a working exploit rather than a written argument.

• Map the real attack surface of a proof. Establish the formal property, the level it holds, the threat model behind it, and the underlying assumptions, then show the client which of those give way under pressure.

• Build the tooling that decides your coverage. Design and extend the AI-driven discovery and triage systems that determine how much of a target a single engineer can reach within a short window.

• Write the assessment that becomes the record. Set out what held, what did not, and what you attempted without success, clearly enough that the result stands up to the product developers.

We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship.

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners. 

By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable and affordable.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

As a Senior Pre-Sales Engineer, you are a "developer-plus" technical contributor. You are responsible for building high-quality mock backends, APIs, and demo infrastructure, but with a unique twist: you leverage LLMs and Generative AI to prototype at high velocity.

This role sits at the critical boundary between Product Engineering and Go-to-Market. While you won't build production systems, you will build "production-shaped" assets: reusable, well-structured, and documented services that enable credible technical storytelling and high-fidelity client validation.

Your core responsibilities will include:

- AI-Accelerated Prototyping: Leverage LLMs (e.g., Claude and Gemini) to rapidly scaffold, build, and iterate on proof-of-concept apps and mock services. You move faster than a traditional sprint by using AI to handle the "heavy lifting" of boilerplate and logic generation.

- Technical Asset Development: Design, build, and maintain reusable mock services in Node.js / TypeScript. You’ll implement contract-first APIs (REST/GraphQL), manage AWS deployments (API Gateway, Containers), and handle persistence using PostgreSQL or DynamoDB

- Infrastructure as Code: Manage demo environments using Terraform, ensuring environments are reproducible and secure using existing OIDC authentication patterns.

- Frontend Collaboration: Work closely with frontend engineers to ensure UI components point cleanly to your mock services, debugging integration issues and supporting end-to-end demo flows.

- Strategic Pre-Sales Support: Partner with Pre-Sales consultants to translate client "win themes" into working technical artefacts. You will occasionally demo directly to clients, showcasing how Kaluza solves their specific retail challenges.

- Product & UX Influence: Collaborate with Design and Product teams for UI direction while developing your own design ideas to make Kaluza’s capabilities shine.

- Mentorship & Standards: Set informal engineering standards for the pre-sales team, mentoring others on API design and architecture.

- AI Evangelism: Act as the resident expert in GenAI workflows for the Commercial team, mentoring others on how to use AI to bridge the gap between "slide-ware" and "software."

What this role is NOT:

- A pure presentation-led role (you will be writing code regularly).

- Shipping production code (your value comes from building things that work for a demo, not maintaining production SLOs).

About You

You are a software engineer by trade but a prototyper by heart. You understand the rigour of clean code but know when to lean into AI to accelerate delivery. You are motivated by the immediate impact of winning new clients and validating Kaluza’s value proposition in real-time.

The role spans the full stack from low-level kernel optimization to distributed system tuning, requiring deep understanding of GPU architecture, model parallelism, memory management, and compiler-level optimization. title: Senior HW Engineer – PCB Analog Design
description: The Opportunity At the centre of an optical computer sits a set of circuits that have to read, drive and hold steady some very small, very fast signals: photodetector front ends, laser and modulator drives, precision converter interfaces, and the quiet power and references underneath them. This role owns them, at board level, from the optical requirement through to the production build. The Role You will design the board-level analog and mixed-signal circuits that connect our electronics to light, and take them the whole way: specification, simulation, layout guidance, lab bring-up, characterisation and production. You will agree the optical requirements - optical power budgets, bandwidth, noise, linearity - with the photonics and system teams, and turn them into analog architectures and circuit specifications. What is genuinely hard about it is working at the boundary between optics, mixed-signal and high-speed digital, where noise budgets are tight and the measurement is as demanding as the design. A microvolt-level front end does not care that the same board carries high-current switching rails; getting both right on one stackup is the job. By month six, you will have characterised at least one full analog subsystem on the bench, correlated it with simulation across corners, and put the layout constraints and test procedures in place that other engineers can follow. What You'll Do Design board-level analog and mixed-signal circuits: photodiode front ends, TIAs, ADC/DAC driver and reconstruction stages, laser drivers, modulator drivers and bias networks.
